nodes.description: Constructor of the Numa contract; empty body, only initializes the contract instance.
Public function newBatch(bytes32 ipfsHash) that emits the NewBatch event with the supplied hash; performs no state mutation, no external call and no value transfer.
bytes32 parameter of newBatch, forwarded unchanged into the emitted NewBatch event log.

edges.reason: The bytes32 ipfsHash parameter is consumed directly by newBatch and written into the NewBatch event; no arithmetic, access check or external interaction is derived from it.
Deployment-time constructor precedes and enables the on-chain availability of the public newBatch entry point.

normalization_plan.reason: The non-core parameter ipfsHash carries no independent semantics and is fully absorbed by the core function newBatch, which is the only consumer of that value.
